_comment: Repository health ratchets. Each metric states its own rule; see doc/BUILD_HEALTH.md for the authoritative table and HealthRatchetTest for enforcement. Ceilings (moduleCount, projectDependencyEdges, todoFixmeMarkers, deprecatedMarkers) fail the build when exceeded. mainSourceFiles is an exact comparison, testSourceFiles is a floor, and releaseApkMibPerAbi is recorded but NOT gated because measuring it needs a full release build. Timing budgets live in doc/BUILD_HEALTH.md and are measured on a schedule, not per-PR.

notes.todoFixmeMarkers: Ceiling only. Do not raise to accommodate new work; record intentional debt in doc/REBUILD_STATUS.md instead.
notes.releaseApkMibPerAbi: Track release, not debug. Debug is ~126 MiB because it is unminified and is not a shipped-payload signal.
notes.mainSourceFiles: Grows legitimately during the reconstruction. Tracked for visibility, not gated, until the legacy deletion task defines a target.
notes.deprecatedMarkers: Ceiling only. Every @Deprecated is a bridge to a replacement path; removing the call site is the improvement.
